lines.en: The wind lifts me a little higher
I cannot fly steady yet, I wobble
My feathers open in the current
I walk on the wind
Half a block off the ground is just right
I run alongside a gust
My wings are small, so I beat them fast
I land on the tips of the grass, light as air
When the wind turns, I turn with it
A faint trail of wind follows me

lines.zh: 我贴着草尖滑了一小段。
lines.en: I skim a short way along the grass tips.
I am small, one circle and I must rest

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上飘来飘去
lines.en: My shadow drifts across the ground
I work my way up the slope
My feathers rise and settle
I push off the air itself
I doze in midair
When the wind stops, I simply hang
My feathers are growing slowly
The wind here is gentle
I cannot make a whirlwind yet
I shake the dew off my wings
A breeze comes from the east

lines.zh: 我用嘴理了理胸前的羽
lines.en: I preen the feathers on my chest
I stand, and the wind holds me up
Cloud shadows pass over me

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方在刮风
lines.en: I hear wind far away
The wind smells of grass
I tuck myself into a small ball
The sun is warm on me
I am too small, one gust moves me
I look down at my own feet
You are tall, I have to look up

lines.zh: 你的帽子被风掀起一角。
lines.en: The wind lifts a corner of your hat.
The wind has messed your hair
I know wind, not people
Your hand comes out, so I edge back
I still carry the wind on me
Your clothes are flapping

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一小阵风
lines.en: A small breeze sits between us
Are you going to touch me
I drift slowly to your front

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把空气推开了
lines.en: Your breath pushes the air aside
I see fire in your hand
The hit made me tilt

lines.zh: 风托着我，羽毛掉了也不慌。
lines.en: Wind holds me; lost feathers don't worry me.
I tilt and drop, then steady myself.
The wind held me, I did not fall
I can still stand
My wing aches
I pulled my neck in
I retreat behind the grass
A few of my down feathers are knocked loose.
I am still a small one
This handful of seeds smells good
The wind carried it my way
I land and come closer slowly
Open your palm flat before I eat
I peck once, very quickly
This much keeps me flying a while
Do not grab me, I get scared
I circle once before eating
Wings open, I have not landed yet
Set it on the ground

lines.zh: 风把香味送到我鼻子里
lines.en: The wind brings the smell to me

lines.zh: 你掌心的种子滚了一下。
lines.en: The seeds in your palm roll once.
Do you have anything else
I eat very carefully
I will take this bite away
Once I eat, I fly back
You touched my wing
The bump knocked me lower
The wind steadied me
I can't raise wind on my own yet.
Our bump made a small gust
You are very warm
I circled by your shoulder
I nearly dropped
I drifted back a little
I did not care for that bump

lines.zh: 同类很少，风里只有一个我
lines.en: My kind are few, only I in this wind

lines.zh: 成年的风之凤凰才能成双
lines.en: Only grown wind phoenixes pair
I am small, I learn to fly first
I hear other wings in the wind
Wait until I grow up
Two flying together would look fine
Our feathers are both light
The wind blows us to one place
We tried a short stretch side by side

lines.zh: 巢边只有我的影子在转。
lines.en: Only my shadow circles the nest.

lines.zh: 我用喙夹住，风差点吹走。
lines.en: I grip it in my beak; the wind nearly takes it.
Too heavy, I cannot lift it

lines.zh: 用爪子扒拉一下，就起来了。
lines.en: One claw scrape and it's up.
This is heavier than wind
I'm small, and the wind already obeys me.
I take off, and it blows away
I pick it up and drop it again
I hug it and land
This much I can carry
I will take it back to the nest
Something moved over there, I saw it
My feathers rose a little
Something is nearing the nest
I'm above and to its side, wind just right.
I circle above it
The wind will tell me where it goes

lines.zh: 那气味让我羽毛全竖起。
lines.en: That smell lifts every feather I have.

lines.zh: 我盘旋着，风绕在我翅下。
lines.en: I circle, wind cupping under my wings.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次正面迎上去
lines.en: This is my first time facing something
It is bigger than I expected
I circle above it
The wind pushes me a little closer

lines.zh: 它每动一次，我就换方向
lines.en: Each time it moves, I change course
I am not good at diving yet
It stopped, and I stopped
I lower my height a little at a time
I hold my wings and glide down
This one must be precise

lines.zh: 我压低翅膀，试着往下扑。
lines.en: I lower my wings and try a first dive.
Not yet, a little closer
Small body, and I still ram.
My claws caught
I peck at it
The wind rushes in with me

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，但我尽力了
lines.en: It was light, but I tried
I was knocked back
I am panting hard
That blow had little force
I pushed it back a little
I drop back to catch my breath
A gust carried me here
I settle on the tips of the grass
My feathers are still damp
I come down from a cloud shadow

lines.zh: 我带着一圈小旋风落地
lines.en: I land with a small whirl of wind

lines.zh: 周围比我出生的地方安静
lines.en: It is quieter here than where I hatched
I landed in your line of sight
This is open enough to practice flying

lines.zh: 一缕小旋风把我放在草上。
lines.en: A small whirlwind sets me on the grass.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次独自出门
lines.en: This is my first time out alone
Fire singed my feathers

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，摔疼了
lines.en: I dropped out of the air and hit hard
Water is too heavy, I cannot rise
The blast blew me far off course

lines.zh: 飞来的东西擦过我的翅膀
lines.en: Something flying grazed my wing

lines.zh: 紫光压住我的翅膀，我挣不开。
lines.en: Purple light pins my wings; I can't pull free.
Hungry, I cannot beat my wings
Lightning came with the wind

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我不会飞
lines.en: No wind in the void, I cannot fly
